results.bound: 5.37\ \text{MB wire in } 0.82\ \text{s server latency on SIFT-1M (HEIR-GPU CKKS)}
results.previous_best: Compass: 12.2 MB over 8 RTTs; Panther: 92.9 MB; SANNS: 1.77 GB
results.quote: Conversely, when rotation keys can be registered for a session, **Holo-NN (CKKS)** is the lowest-wire single-server cryptographic system measured on SIFT-1M: **11.13** MB at _M_=300,000 (**29.7**s on a single RTX 3090 GPU via Phantom, or **9.5**s at _M_=98,300 for **4.24**MB), and **5.37** MB in **0.82**s under 32-bit RNS **HEIR-GPU** (**2.10** MB in **0.26**s at _M_=98,300, and **8.65** MB in **1.30**s at _M_=500,000) against Compass’s 12.2 MB, Panther’s 92.9 MB, and SANNS’s 1.77 GB, in _one_ round trip rather than Compass’s eight, SANNS/Panther’s multi-round 2PC, or Pacmann’s twenty to thirty-two, with no client-side index state and no preprocessing stream.
